设置参数`status`进行强制状态渲染。.en-us: Use `status` to force a status style.

设置参数`placement`控制悬浮层展开方位。.en-us: Use `placement` to set the popup placement.

通过参数`maxCount`控制树选择组件的最大可选项数。.en-us: Use `maxCount` to limit selections in the tree selector.

多选模式下，设置参数`maxTagPlaceholder`控制隐藏已选值tag时.en-us: Use `maxTagPlaceholder` in multiple selection mode to customize the hidden selection placeholder.

多选模式下，设置参数`maxTagTextLength`控制最大显示的已选值ta.en-us: Use `maxTagTextLength` in multiple selection mode to limit selected-tag text length.

通过参数`prefix`设置选择框内嵌前缀内容。.en-us: Use `prefix` to embed prefix content in the selection input.

设置参数`suffixIcon`自定义选择框后缀图标。.en-us: Use `suffixIcon` to customize the selection input's suffix icon.

设置参数`switcherIcon`自定义树节点的展开/折叠图标。.en-us: Use `switcherIcon` to customize tree node expand/collapse icons.

多选模式下设置参数`treeCheckable=True`为节点添加勾选框。.en-us: Set `treeCheckable=True` in multiple selection mode to add node checkboxes.

设置参数`treeDataMode='flat'`后可传入扁平结构`treeDa.en-us: Set `treeDataMode='flat'` and provide flat `treeData` to define the tree.

设置参数`treeCheckStrictly=True`后父子节点选择行为彼此独.en-us: Set `treeCheckStrictly=True` to make parent and child selection independent.

设置参数`showCheckedStrategy`控制已选项回填显示策略。.en-us: Use `showCheckedStrategy` to control how selected items are displayed.

设置参数`treeNodeFilterMode`控制搜索模式。.en-us: Use `treeNodeFilterMode` to choose the search mode.

设置参数`enableAsyncLoad=True`后，对于未设置`isLeaf.en-us: Set `enableAsyncLoad=True` to monitor expansion of nodes that have no `children` and do not set `isLeaf` to `True`, then update the tree asynchronously through callbacks.
